findings.summary: Marrowline-int8 achieves slightly lower translation quality than Selk-MT (chrF 57.9 vs 58.4) on the Ombria-News test set, a difference of 0.5 points.
findings.caveats: No statistical test reported; difference may not be significant.

findings.summary: Marrowline-int8 has substantially lower serving latency than Selk-MT: p50 97 ms vs 186 ms and p99 0.61 s vs 1.24 s on the replayed production trace.
findings.scope: Replayed production trace on Pellmar P2, p50 and p99 latency
findings.caveats: No statistical test reported; single hardware and trace.

findings.summary: Marrowline-int4 shows a larger quality drop (chrF 55.2 vs 58.4) but even lower latency (p50 71 ms, p99 0.46 s) compared to Selk-MT.
findings.scope: Ombria-News test set and replayed production trace
findings.caveats: No statistical test reported; int4 not the primary comparison but relevant.

sentences.text: On the Ombria-News test set, Marrowline-int8 achieves a chrF of 57.9 versus 58.4 for Selk-MT, a difference of 0.5 points, though no statistical test was reported.
In serving latency on the replayed production trace, Marrowline-int8 reduces p50 from 186 ms to 97 ms and p99 from 1.24 s to 0.61 s compared with Selk-MT.
Marrowline-int4 shows a larger quality drop (chrF 55.2 vs 58.4) but even lower latency (p50 71 ms, p99 0.46 s) relative to Selk-MT.
